name: Card Pocket
summary: A payment picker where each method is a card in a leather wallet slot that slides up when chosen
about: Four payment methods (debit card, mobile wallet, bank transfer and cash on delivery) sit in staggered slots of a navy leather wallet with brass stitching. Choosing one wiggles it loose, slides it out of its slot and lifts it on top with a shine, while the fee or discount and the total update in PKR. Paying slides the card home, folds the lid shut, runs a glowing stitch round the edge and stamps it PAID.
how: Click a card strip or use the arrow keys: the card wiggles, slides out of its slot and settles on top with a shine
The card shows its details, and the discount or fee row and the PKR total roll to the new amount
Choosing another card first slides the current one back into its own slot
Press Pay: the card tips back and slides home, the lid folds down and the brass snap clicks
A glowing stitch runs round the lid as progress, then PAID (or BOOKED for cash) is stamped with sparkles
